reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Keep Element 41 range and card-brand width boundaries separate from fuel-sale applicability, net fuel amount calculations, and Segment 157 reconciliation.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Synthetic field-level designs only; complete Segment 100 transaction and card-brand context require review.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References existing Segment 100 fuel amount semantics without changing the official Test baseline.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must confirm card-brand selection, fuel-sale applicability, assumed decimal serialization, and expected outcomes before promotion or execution.

requirementReferences.title: Fuel Purchase Amount (Segment 100 Element 41) has valid values 1-99999999; representation is limited to eight digits for American Express and seven digits for other card types.
Fuel Purchase Amount follows the net fuel amount rule

sourceEvidence.quote: Number: 41 Name: Fuel Purchase Amount Character Type: N Maximum Length: 8 bytes
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Element 41 is numeric with an eight-byte maximum.

sourceEvidence.quote: Representation: Variable length of up to eight digits with two assumed decimal places
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The field is variable-length with two assumed decimal places.

sourceEvidence.quote: A maximum length of 8 bytes is allowed for American Express cards only. A maximum length of 7 bytes is allowed for all other card types.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Eight digits apply only to Amex; all other card types are limited to seven.

sourceEvidence.quote: Purpose: Identifies the total dollar amount of all fuel sold for this transaction.
Processing Rules: Included on any transactions with fuel sales.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The element applies to transactions with fuel sales.
The general valid-value range is 1 through 99999999, subject to the card-specific representation limits.

aiBrs.claim: Fuel Purchase Amount max length is 8 bytes for American Express cards only; 7 bytes for all other card types.
Valid values for Fuel Purchase Amount are 1-99999999.

aiReviewReferences.assessment: Both AI claims match ATL105: range 1-99999999 and Amex-only eight-digit width versus seven digits for others. The claims omit two assumed decimal places and fuel-sale applicability. All 11 hash-verified cases declare Element 41 omitted, so none demonstrates range, width, or fuel amount semantics.

testScenarios.intent: For an authorized fuel-sale Segment 100 Amex context, exercise the valid eight-digit upper bound and the first value above the documented valid range.
For an authorized fuel-sale Segment 100 non-Amex context, exercise the valid seven-digit upper bound and the first value above the card-specific width.

testCases.assertion: Amex Element 41 value 99999999 is within the documented valid range and eight-digit width.
Amex Element 41 value 100000000 exceeds both the valid-value ceiling and maximum length.
Non-Amex Element 41 value 9999999 is within the documented seven-digit width.
Non-Amex Element 41 value 10000000 exceeds the documented seven-digit width.

openQuestions: Confirm card-brand/type encoding and how the Amex width exception is selected in complete Segment 100 fixtures.
Confirm fuel-sale applicability and two-decimal serialization; the draft does not calculate net fuel amounts or discount allocation.
Review full requests and expected outcomes with the authorized Test owner before promotion or execution.
